citywide.note: The tally's 48.6% is its respondents' mix (K, 5th, 6th, 9th and mixed classes), not every grade. The model's all-students figure weights the grade curve by CDE Census Day enrolment by grade (data/school-case/enrolment-sf.json) at the schools modelled, with grades 10-12 held at 9th's 33%; Trend continues the 6th-9th line instead. The tally basis is 48.6 plus the modelled change in each band's car share weighted by the tally's respondent weights.

source.what: SFUSD Public Data Dashboard, Enrollment Overview (2025-26), Site-Level Enrollment by SF Zip Code

solo.note: Our assumption. A student can go without a caregiver on foot or by bike from walkGrade or bikeGrade up when the trip is at most maxMin minutes and the bike route's total gap off the all-ages network is at most gapTotalFt; on Muni or a yellow bus from transitGrade up.

safeTrip.note: Students whose chosen trip is a safe one of at most 15 minutes: walking or biking with the bike route's total gap at most 1,000 ft, or Muni door to door in 15 minutes or less (scheduled times, muni_times).

crashes.source: out/school-hour-crashes/schools.json (scripts/school-hour-crashes.py): injury crashes within 600 ft (182.88 m) of the school at its own bell hours on school days, 2022-23 to 2025-26
crashes.fiveYear: a 5-year total: the four school years' count x 5/4

crashes.scenarioMethod: exposure-based change only: today's count times the change in family-car miles on the school's expected trips; no crash modification factor

outcomes.cases: School Street and the programs apply first; then, in each case, every cell's bike logit moves by lambda x caseD x the rise in its route's on-network share over today's, the other modes scaled in proportion. Year 10 of the ten-year horizon.
